newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins steady, eye US Treasuries for trend.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins steady, eye US Treasuries for trend.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were steady in quiet range-trading, awaiting trend ideas from U.S. Treasuries, with few trade days remaining ahead of the annual interest payment due in mid-May, dealers said.
"The market is taking a spring nap as we have just a few trading days for MinFins," Eurobank dealer Olivier Coursault said. "There is not much activity, no client interest."
"The market is completely linked to U.S. Treasuries and they are quiet, with traders staying on the waiting side," he added.
U.S. statistic data is due next week and it is likely to make the future of U.S. interest rates clearer.
But dealers said some buying activity was seen in thin trading, mainly in the fourth and fifth tranches.
"Vnesh debt firmed today and MinFins have tracked them," an International Moscow Bank dealer said and added demand was apparently coming from London operators.
